Differentiate the function f(x) with respect to x to get f'(x). Set f'(x) equal to zero and solve for x. These are potential stationary points. Then plug each value back into the original function to get the corresponding y-values. You can check if it's a max or min using second derivative test.
replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: PCA reduces data dimension by finding principal components that capture most variance. First, standardize your data and compute the covariance matrix.
